Verification.label: 03 / TECHNICAL VERIFICATION
Verification.title: Technical Verification
Verification.subtitle: Independent curation system based on objective data and selection criteria from local and global expert groups

01.title: SINGLE ORIGIN BOTANICALS
01.desc: By analyzing single-origin Korean ingredients (rice, fruits, grains) from specific regional terroirs, we select spirits and traditional wine & spirits with controlled off-notes and pure aromatic structures.

02.title: INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION
02.desc: Excluding commercial branding, we rigorously verify refined spirits from an objective third-party perspective through technical standards and sensory evaluation conducted with Korean and global spirits and gastronomy experts.

03.title: SENSORY DATA ARCHIVING
03.desc: By systematically archiving chemical and sensory data of spirits, we provide objective quality assurance standards for Korean spirits.

Manifesto.label: 05 / BRAND MANIFESTO
Manifesto.title: The Gateway to Korean Wine & Spirits
Manifesto.desc1: Oryza & Co. is more than a distribution platform.
Manifesto.desc2: We build objective quality standards by quantifying the unstandardized terroir and sensory metrics of Korean traditional wine & spirits.
Manifesto.desc3: Free from unverified commercial rhetoric, we serve as the rigorous gateway establishing Korean wine & spirits as a distinct, legitimate category in the global gastronomy market.

step1.title: Heritage & The Missing Language
step1.desc1: Korea has fermented rice for over a millennium, with 13th-century Silk Road distillation creating its heritage spirits. Despite substantial global volume, its presence in fine dining remains minimal due to the lack of a quantitative technical language.

step2.title: Botanical Origin & Data Architecture
step2.desc1: Oryza & Co. derives its identity from Oryza, the botanical genus of rice. Grounded in systematic taxonomy, we profile chemical components and sensory data to redefine Korean spirits into a precise global standard for gastronomy.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
Oryza & Co. ('Company') values your personal information and complies with applicable data protection regulations.

1. Information Collected
- Items: Name, Position/Title, Email, Phone Number, Company/Brewery Name, Country & City, Spirit Category, Inquiry Details.

2. Purpose of Collection
- Processing liquid verification requests, issuing sensory data sheets (PDF), consulting on annual volume allocations, and B2B inquiry management.

3. Retention Period
- Information is retained for 1 year following inquiry completion and destroyed promptly thereafter.

4. Data Processing Outsourcing
- Email transmission services are processed via Web3Forms strictly for contact form handling.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content:
1. Purpose of Platform
This website is a B2B data platform providing quantitative chemical component analysis and sensory curation data for Korean spirits.

2. No Direct Sales or Payments
This website DOES NOT facilitate direct online payments, e-commerce transactions, or direct sales of alcohol. All allocations and commercial terms are discussed through individual B2B channels.

3. Intellectual Property
All data, text, branding, and design assets on this site are the exclusive intellectual property of Oryza & Co.

license.title: Data Usage License
license.content:
1. Permitted Scope of Use
Quantitative analysis sheets and sensory data PDFs issued by the Company are licensed solely for non-commercial evaluation by buyers, sommeliers, and trade experts.

2. Prohibited Actions
- Unauthorized redistribution, resale, or transfer to third parties without written consent.
- Alteration, modification, or falsification of data metrics and graphs.
- Automated scraping or data extraction from this website.
